notes: ISSUER IS A PHARMACY (ร้านยา), not a hospital. hospital_name records the printed issuer name verbatim; the 'hospital' field is a best fit for a pharmacy receipt, so expect a possible mismatch in any hospital-name check. Thai numerals (๐-๙) are printed throughout: kept verbatim in text fields (item descriptions, name), while dates and amounts are normalized. Date 'วันที่ ๒๒ มี.ค. ๒๕๖๗' = 22 March 2567 (Buddhist era) -> 2024-03-22. Items sum: 30.00 + 84.00 + 65.00 + 40.00 = 219.00 = grand_total (๒๑๙.๐๐ บาท, words agree). Item 2 description wraps over two lines in print; joined here. Printed as VAT-inclusive; there is no VAT field. Time 18:05 and receipt number are not schema fields. The PDF text layer is garbled (duplicated Thai glyphs), so all values were taken from the rendered page, not the text layer.
